outcome_analysis: MicroEval was a two-person Summer 2012 YC company that launched frequent micro-reviews via TechCrunch in August 2012. CB Insights shows only a roughly 20K YC investment and marks it dead, and YC lists it inactive. The cause is not public, so failure factors are left empty.
notes: microeval.com did not resolve (DNS failure when fetched). The 20K YC figure rests on CB Insights alone and is unverified; YC's standard deal is not a round and is recorded only because a database reports it. Funding searches found nothing else. YC page lists Sam O'Keefe and Ernie Park with much later roles, so prior employers may postdate 2012 and their founder status rests on the YC page alone. Competitor search returned only 2026 buyer guides; no dated rivals recorded.
